# Peoria Junk Removal Pros

## About
Peoria Junk Removal Pros is a locally owned junk hauling company serving Peoria, IL and the surrounding communities. We pick up furniture, appliances, construction debris, yard waste, and handle full estate and commercial cleanouts. Same-day service is available across our coverage area.

## Services
- Furniture Removal (sofas, mattresses, tables, chairs)
- Appliance Hauling (refrigerators, washers, dryers, dishwashers)
- Construction Debris Removal (drywall, lumber, tile, concrete, renovation waste)
- Yard Waste Removal (brush, branches, old fencing, dirt, stumps)
- Estate Cleanouts (full-property clearance for families, agents, and executors)
- Commercial Cleanouts (offices, retail spaces, storage units)
- General Junk Hauling (single items or whole-property loads)

## Service Area
Peoria, Peoria Heights, East Peoria, Dunlap, Chillicothe, Washington, Morton, Bartonville, Metamora, Tazewell County, Peoria County, Woodford County

## Why Choose Us
Locally operated out of Peoria, we show up when we say we will and haul everything away in one trip. We handle the heavy lifting, disposal, and cleanup — you just point at what needs to go. Free quotes with no pressure, no commitment.
